originalEntry.title: Distilbook promo in a reference video's style
originalEntry.title_zh: 仿参考视频的产品宣传片
originalEntry.author: ajith_io
originalEntry.description: A 30-second code-made promo for Distilbook that reuses the visual style of a reference video Opus downloads itself; the final cut has no manual edits.
originalEntry.description_zh: 用代码做的 30 秒 Distilbook 宣传片，Opus 自己下载参考视频并沿用它的视觉风格，成片没有手改。
originalEntry.prompt:
Take reference from the given video (download it) and use the same visual style.
and Research about Distilbook. Make a dynamic 30-second motion graphics video on Distilbook that shows what an incredible motion designer you are. like it's your showreel - Go all out.
One thing to keep in mind: it should be cool as fck.
originalEntry.prompt_zh:
参考给定的视频（把它下载下来），使用同样的视觉风格。
然后研究一下 Distilbook。制作一段关于 Distilbook 的 30 秒动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师。就像你的作品集一样——拿出全部本事。
有一点要记住：它必须酷到爆。
originalEntry.note: Author: final version, no manual edits.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称这是最终版，没有手动修改。
